parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and `null` values for `differing_slots`, `shared_ancestor`, and `shared_field_count`, leaving no grounded evidence about the actual fields or methods of `PlayWXYC` and `ToggleWXYC` beyond their file paths and a Jaccard similarity of 0.75. While the two types in `Shared/Intents/Sources/Intents/` share structural shape, `PlayWXYC` and `ToggleWXYC` encode semantically distinct SiriKit/App Intents actions (play vs. toggle), and without member-level evidence it is not safe to prescribe a concrete refactoring. Recommending extraction or protocol introduction without grounded field/method data risks introducing an incorrect abstraction.
